text_block_list.text: Oh no! I'm gonna be late!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list: Well, this is certainly a rare sight.

text_block_list.text:
Oh, good morning! You see, the newest
volume
took a totally unexpected turn—
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I mean, I was reading a book last night...
and
suddenly it was morning... Hehe...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Oops... Time to go stretch my facial
muscles.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан yawns again as she makes
her way
through the school gates, her
exhaustion plain to
see.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
